excellenceBehaviours.description: Explain how a change in neuron structure or function produces an evidence pattern, rather than only naming the affected part.
Interpret and draw membrane-voltage-versus-time graphs, relate ion movement to polarity, and explain intensity using threshold and all-or-none signalling.
Explain excitatory and inhibitory effects, summation, and how an external chemical changes synaptic transmission.
Infer a changed nervous-system or reflex-arc location from data or symptoms and justify the prediction while recognizing limits.
Interpret sensory pathway evidence, predict effects of structural change, and connect observations to visual, auditory, equilibrium, or receptor function.
Analyze hormone and blood or urine data, locate feedback disruptions, and compare related hormone roles in homeostasis.
Integrate nervous and endocrine control, compare short- and long-term stress responses, and interpret hormone-imbalance evidence.
